designRules: Start with an explicit pair or finite set of mechanisms, not a single favored model.
Fold every mechanism through the same detector response before comparing it with data.
Include calibration, acceptance, drift and background tangents in the nuisance span.
If efficient separation is zero, do not add repetitions; add an orientation, frequency, geometry, waiting-time or higher-moment channel.
Choose the added channel before looking at the disputed data and price its calibration cost.
Validate on positive and negative controls and reserve a held-out control setting.
Report the detector-equivalence class when no affordable channel breaks it.
